description:
Introducing an extraordinary collection of  Luxury Estepona apartments for sale with stunning sea views designed for discerning buyers seeking the finest in coastal living. With premium onsite amenities and exceptional finishes, these homes provide a lifestyle that combines comfort, elegance, and sophistication.

Located along the prestigious New Golden Mile, this remarkable residential project combining breathtaking views and impeccable design, features a selection of 72 exquisite 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, designed across seven elegant three-storey buildings, each thoughtfully designed to maximise the views of the Mediterranean and the surrounding mountains.

This development ensures that each home is flooded with natural light and enjoys the refreshing sea breeze. Choose from ground-floor apartments with expansive private gardens, well-planned mid-floor units, or stunning penthouses featuring solariums and private plunge pools. Every home is equipped with contemporary designer kitchens, perfectly blending style with functionality.

Residents will enjoy premium amenities that include a state-of-the-art fitness centre, a lavish spa, both indoor and outdoor pools, secure access, and round-the-clock security services, with optional private pools available in most units.

Estepona is part of the coveted Golden Triangle of the Costa del Sol, comprising Marbella, Benahavís, and Estepona itself, which has become synonymous with luxury real estate in Europe. With over 300 days of sunshine per year, this region provides an ideal climate for an active lifestyle, whether you prefer golfing, water sports, or exploring scenic hiking trails. The area is rich in leisure, dining, and entertainment options, offering a vibrant community for residents.

Situated in the emerging La Resina area, spanning 100 hectares, the location combines peaceful surroundings with spectacular sea views, all while being conveniently close to essential services and amenities. A short drive will take you to the glamorous Puerto Banus, the charming Nueva Andalucía, and the stunning local beaches and marina. Additionally, the proximity to both Gibraltar and Málaga airports provides effortless connectivity for international travel.

This is modern living at its finest—where every day feels like a holiday and every moment is a testament to luxury. Our dedicated team is ready to help you find your dream home. For enquiries about availability, pricing, or specific features, contact us today for personalised assistance and detailed information!
